title: Algorithmic Redistricting: Elections made-to-order
summary: AlphaPhoenix uses Monte Carlo simulation and annealing-style methods to draw North Carolina congressional district maps, both gerrymandered and fair. He focuses on the fascinating computational problem rather than the politics.
why: HN recommends it as an entertaining demonstration of how powerful algorithmic gerrymandering can be.

quote.text: For a great (and entertaining!) look into how you can use simulations to generate these types of maps
